notes.title: A New Year's miracle!
notes.content:
In honor of the new year, we have added a themed update with festive content to the game.:

- a small New Year's level
- a festive hat 
- snowball (soccer ball skin)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099181/6031a736c7fc986b6ff35f3100f3dca43bf92c37.png

as well as part of the content of the larger pokachi update, which was already ready! (but not to the end)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099181/3b902065e0762f4fabc3f9810beafb9d4880a779.jpg

Thank you all for playing our game and supporting its development, we will continue to try to please you with new content next year!

Happy New Year! GOOOOOAL

notes.title: Future plans and a small bug fix
notes.content:
I want to thank everyone for the warm welcome! I am very glad that many people liked the game and now I am even more motivated to work on the game further!

First of all, it is planned to:
- expand the existing levels of the game and remake the "ending" to a more interesting one
- Add new weapons and boss fight! 
- Add several new mini-games and events
- Add Achievements!
- Trade cards! (when steam allows them to be added)
and maybe something else...

After that, you can start adding new levels and content!

A small patch with fixes was also released: 
- Fixed a few minor bugs in the game
- Fixed a problem with the resolution in the game  (keep in mind that the game is designed for a 16:9 monitor ratio, so it may not be very convenient to play for square or long monitors, so you can switch to screen mode or I can add a setting with black stripes on the edges if it is more convenient)

If there is any problem due to the changes or you just found a bug, you can write here in the comments or in the Steam discussions, but I hope everything will work fine.
